title: EXP-019 v1.2 DRAFT request capture artifact (non-executable)
description: DRAFT schema for the prospective EXP-019 v1.2 evidence contract. NOT a frozen protocol and NOT executable: v1.2 is not registered in frozen_protocol(). This records the contemporaneous capture taken AT REQUEST SUBMISSION, before any image could have been returned. It therefore cannot evidence a returned image; that is the separate response capture. A capture is a rendering of the operator's client view: it is NOT authenticated host-received request bytes, and it must never be described as such.

attachment_count.description: Number of files attached to the generation request. The v1.2 requirement is zero.

paste_sha256.description: Digest of the operator's clipboard bytes before submission. This is the byte-exact claim, compared against the frozen prompt digest.

rendered_request_text_sha256.description: Digest of the request text as rendered by the client interface.

rendered_request_comparison.description: How the rendered request text was compared with the paste bytes. Only a textual comparison is achievable; a byte-identity claim against a host-internal request payload is NOT available for ChatGPT Images.

host_authenticated_request_bytes.description: Present only when the interface genuinely exposes an authenticated request record. Absent otherwise; it is never fabricated.
